zh-CN.title: 通知设置更贴合当前空间
items: 通知与提醒只展示当前空间已开放的聊天、广场、投稿和科研类别
按类型与按渠道保持一致，隐藏类别的原有偏好仍会保留

en.title: Notifications tailored to your space
items: Notification settings only show Chat, Square, Submissions and Research when enabled in the current space
Type and channel views stay consistent, while preferences for hidden categories are preserved
